description: This Java source file defines the ProductConfigWrapper class and its inner classes ConfigItem and ConfigOption. The class manages product configuration data, including options, pricing, and selection state, for use in an e-commerce or product customization context within the OFBiz framework. It loads product information, calculates prices, manages configurations, and provides methods to manipulate and retrieve product configuration details.
